observations.why: Directive issued as a standing order — authority of position establishing a recurring process by fiat.

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: Aphoristic equivalence framed as logical argument — an unrehearsed rollback equals no rollback — persuading via reasoning rather than rank.

mints.name: AphoristicEquivalenceAsWarrant
mints.title: a thing we have not rehearsed is a thing we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the speaker warranting a directive by compressing the rationale into a memorable equivalence, rather than by citing rank or evidence?
